<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="24" y="23" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">9:41</text>
    <line x1="315" y1="18" x2="315" y2="23" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="16" x2="320" y2="23" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="325" y1="14" x2="325" y2="23" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="339" cy="19" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="343" y1="23" x2="347" y2="27" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="355" y="14" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <rect x="358" y="17" width="14" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
    <rect x="376" y="17" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header controls -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="76" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">CONTRA</text>
    <g>
      <rect x="319" y="54" width="47" height="32" rx="16" fill="#F4F5F7" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="342.5" y="75" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">SKIP</text>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Illustration shadow -->
  <ellipse cx="195" cy="479" rx="104" ry="13" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.12"/>
  
  <!-- Orange circular illustration area -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="285" r="157" fill="#F95A2C" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="195" cy="285" r="132" fill="#FF9692" opacity="0.28"/>
  
  <!-- Decorative illustration elements -->
  <circle cx="104" cy="181" r="7" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="282" cy="382" r="8" fill="#00C6AE" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="286" y1="204" x2="300" y2="190" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3"/>
  <line x1="300" y1="204" x2="286" y2="190" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3"/>
  <polygon points="111,347 119,362 136,365 124,377 127,394 111,386 96,394 99,377 87,365 104,362" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Seated character -->
  <g>
    <!-- hair -->
    <circle cx="196" cy="188" r="36" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="185" r="27" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="204" cy="196" r="25" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- face -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="216" r="31" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="184" cy="214" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="205" cy="214" r="3" fill="#18191F"/>
    <line x1="190" y1="228" x2="201" y2="228" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- torso -->
    <path d="M162 253 Q195 235 228 253 L245 340 L151 340 Z" fill="#1947E5" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- left arm -->
    <path d="M164 260 Q142 279 132 312 L153 320 L178 284" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- right arm -->
    <path d="M224 263 Q248 275 258 300 L239 311 L213 285" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- hand and laptop -->
    <circle cx="244" cy="304" r="9" fill="#FFF4CC" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="164" y="292" width="77" height="49" rx="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <rect x="172" y="300" width="61" height="33" rx="2" fill="#D6FCF7"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="312" x2="215" y2="312" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="181" y1="319" x2="205" y2="319" stroke="#1947E5" stroke-width="2"/>
    <polygon points="153,341 250,341 260,350 144,350" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- legs -->
    <path d="M170 342 Q166 383 132 403 L145 419 Q190 402 202 354" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M202 348 Q222 375 256 383 L250 402 Q204 394 184 363" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- shoes -->
    <ellipse cx="137" cy="412" rx="22" ry="10" fill="#18191F"/>
    <ellipse cx="253" cy="394" rx="22" ry="10" fill="#18191F"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Content -->
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="527" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="27" font-weight="800" fill="#18191F">Find your next creative partner</text>
    <text x="32" y="570" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">Connect with independent talent, discover</text>
    <text x="32" y="592" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="500" fill="#474A57">great work, and bring your ideas to life.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Progress and next -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="32" cy="654" r="6" fill="#18191F"/>
    <circle cx="52" cy="654" r="6" fill="#EEEFF4" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="72" cy="654" r="6" fill="#EEEFF4" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <rect x="289" y="622" width="69" height="60" rx="16" fill="#18191F" opacity="0.16"/>
      <rect x="289" y="618" width="69" height="60" rx="16" fill="#FFBD12" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polyline points="316,648 326,658 316,668" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <line x1="308" y1="658" x2="326" y2="658" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="754" width="390" height="90" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="754" x2="390" y2="754" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Home -->
    <g>
      <polygon points="42,786 53,777 64,786" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="46" y="785" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#18191F" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="53" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#18191F">Home</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Discover -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="142" cy="787" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="149" y1="794" x2="156" y2="801" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="142" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#9FA4B4">Discover</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Messages -->
    <g>
      <rect x="219" y="778" width="22" height="16" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <polygon points="224,794 224,800 230,794" fill="#9FA4B4"/>
      <circle cx="225" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#9FA4B4"/>
      <circle cx="231" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#9FA4B4"/>
      <circle cx="237" cy="786" r="1.5" fill="#9FA4B4"/>
      <text x="230" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#9FA4B4">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <!-- Profile -->
    <g>
      <circle cx="329" cy="783" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="329" cy="797" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#9FA4B4" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="329" y="819" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Montserrat, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="700" fill="#9FA4B4">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
